purpose: Read-only timing comparison to motivate a longer own-state reset lead-in
method: Accumulate recorded visible-score rewards. Within each recorded life, identify changes of the current 20-point progress bin. Skip triggers with insufficient same-life history, and identify the actual earlier frame t-lookback. Report the last eligible candidate in each life. This computes indices only; it does not create or restore emulator snapshots.
limitations: One selected stage-1 replay; not a representative sample of the continuing learners' reset archives.
Candidates are not necessarily retained or selected by bounded archives, reservoir sampling or peer sharing.
Visible ship-count loss can lag the physical collision; these are not exact collision lead times.
No replay actions or candidate frame indices are passed into training. The proposed experiment changes only the generic lookback length used on the new learner's own experience.
More lead-in is a hypothesis, not evidence of improved play or a supplied route.
